description: This PHP source file defines a data transfer object (DTO) class PimDefinedReportSearchFilterParams within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends FilterParams and manages search filter parameters for reports, specifically including 'name' and 'reportId' properties, along with their getter and setter methods. It sets a default sort field upon instantiation and restricts sort fields to 'report.name'.

classes.name: PimDefinedReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for defining search filter parameters related to Pim-defined reports, including 'name' and 'reportId' with a preset sort field.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'report.name'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'name' filter parameter.

methods.name: getReportId
methods.description: Returns the current value of the 'reportId' filter parameter.
